% The polynomial hierarchy (generated by figs_c3ch10.py).
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=12mm,y=11mm,every node/.style={font=\small},

\node[c] (P) at (0,0) {$\mathsf P$};
\node[c] (S1) at (-1.5,1.3) {$\mathsf{NP}=\Sigma_1^p$};
\node[c] (Q1) at (1.5,1.3) {$\mathsf{coNP}=\Pi_1^p$};
\draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (P) -- (S1); \draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (P) -- (Q1);
\node[c] (S2) at (-1.5,2.6) {$\Sigma_2^p$};
\node[c] (Q2) at (1.5,2.6) {$\Pi_2^p$};
\draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (S1) -- (S2); \draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (S1) -- (Q2);
\draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (Q1) -- (S2); \draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (Q1) -- (Q2);
\node[c] (S3) at (-1.5,3.9000000000000004) {$\Sigma_3^p$};
\node[c] (Q3) at (1.5,3.9000000000000004) {$\Pi_3^p$};
\draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (S2) -- (S3); \draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (S2) -- (Q3);
\draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (Q2) -- (S3); \draw[-{Stealth},MidnightBlue!70] (Q2) -- (Q3);
\node at (0,4.6) {$\vdots$};
\node[c,fill=BurntOrange!15,draw=BurntOrange] (PH) at (0,5.4) {$\mathsf{PH}$};

\draw[-{Stealth},BurntOrange] (PH) -- (PS);
\node[font=\scriptsize,align=left,anchor=west] at (2.7,1.3) {$\exists y\ V(x,y)$};
\node[font=\scriptsize,align=left,anchor=west] at (2.7,2.6) {$\exists y_1\forall y_2\ V(x,y_1,y_2)$};
\node[font=\scriptsize,align=left,anchor=west] at (2.7,3.9) {$\exists y_1\forall y_2\exists y_3\ V(\dots)$};
